findings.title: A direction icon that points the wrong way
findings.message: "الamericas back" is not mirrored in right-to-left. Check it points the way the reader moves.
findings.fix: Mirror it in RTL with a :dir(rtl) { transform: scaleX(-1) } rule, or swap to the opposite icon.

findings.message: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic" is named but never loaded.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".
